finding_01_headline: A competitor already sells in MetalCo's target channel.
finding_01_context: Spanish contractors moved more of their purchasing online in 2024. [1]
finding_01_action_taken: Hierros García launched an online steel marketplace in Spain in March 2025. [1]
finding_01_result_achieved: Hierros García reported 1,200 registered contractors by June 2025. [1]
finding_02_headline: The online shift in wholesale is large enough to matter.
finding_02_context: EU wholesale firms have digitised ordering since 2020. [2]
finding_02_action_taken: Eurostat reported online B2B sales at 23% of wholesale turnover in 2024. [2]
finding_03_headline: Distributor channel conflict is the main launch risk.
finding_03_context: Portuguese distributors depend on exclusive regional agreements. [3]
finding_03_action_taken: Ferro Norte paused its online pilot after two distributors objected in 2024. [3]
finding_03_result_achieved: Ferro Norte relaunched the pilot as a distributor-led portal in 2025. [3]
sources_market_01: [1] Hierros García, press release, 2025; [2] Eurostat, B2B e-commerce, 2024; [3] Jornal de Negócios, 2025
next_step_01: Confirm engagement scope, length and the stakeholders on both sides.
next_step_02: Develop the detailed phase plan and deliverables.
next_step_03: Agree commercial terms and the project team before kickoff.

basis.governing_question: How can MetalCo sell directly to small and mid-size contractors in Portugal and Spain through an online marketplace without losing its regional distributors?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the marketplace blueprint and pilot plan for contractors in Portugal and Spain while keeping regional distributors.

gate.label: Go/no-go on pilot
gate.decision: Does the blueprint justify running a pilot in one region?

phases.name: Pilot
phases.objective_one_line: Launch a first marketplace version to contractors in one region and test it against the repeat-order and distributor criteria.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Is the pilot evidence enough to take the scale-up case to the 2027 budget round?

workstreams.name: Marketplace hypotheses
workstreams.answers: Which assumptions about contractors, distributors and the marketplace must hold for the blueprint to work?
activities: Draft hypotheses on each blueprint component
Confirm the hypotheses with the CEO and Head of Sales

workstreams.name: Demand and channel evidence
workstreams.answers: What do contractors and regional distributors need, and where does direct selling conflict with the distributors?
activities: Interview small and mid-size contractors on how they buy
Interview regional distributors on channel conflict
Analyze order data from the existing B2B ordering portal

workstreams.name: Blueprint and pilot plan
workstreams.answers: What does the marketplace blueprint look like once tested, and how will the pilot in one region run?
activities: Assemble the blueprint from the tested hypotheses
Plan the pilot in one region week by week

workstreams.name: Distributor alignment
workstreams.answers: Which KPIs and distributor arrangements keep the regional distributors on board during the pilot?
activities: Agree pilot KPIs with the CEO, Head of Sales and council
Work with distributors on their role in the pilot region
Track distributor contracts and concerns during the pilot

workstreams.name: Pilot contractor group
workstreams.answers: Which contractors in the pilot region will be the first to use the marketplace?
activities: Analyze order data to find likely first contractors
Interview contractors in the pilot region on their needs

workstreams.name: Marketplace first version
workstreams.answers: Do contractors in the pilot region place first and repeat orders on the marketplace?
activities: Build the first version of the marketplace
Launch to a small group of contractors in the pilot region
Analyze pilot orders and contractor feedback each week

workstreams.name: Scale-up business case
workstreams.answers: What would scaling the marketplace beyond the pilot region require, given the pilot results?
activities: Analyze pilot results and distributor reactions
Draft the business case and implementation plan
Draft the roadmap beyond the pilot region

deliverables.name: Hypotheses on each marketplace blueprint component
Contractor and distributor evidence on the hypotheses
Detailed pilot plan for one region
Pilot KPIs agreed with key stakeholders
Distributor engagement plan for the pilot region
First contractor target group in the pilot region
First marketplace version launched to pilot contractors
Pilot results on repeat orders and distributor contracts
Scale-up business case with implementation plan and roadmap

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align on scope and success criteria
events.decision: Are the scope and success criteria confirmed as the basis for the work?
agenda: Present the governing question and the plan of work
Confirm the success criteria and the pilot region
Align on roles and the meeting calendar

events.label: Check-in: early evidence
events.decision: Is the evidence on the hypotheses enough to start the blueprint?
agenda: Review the hypotheses on each blueprint component
Discuss early contractor and distributor evidence
Confirm the focus of the blueprint work

events.label: Go/no-go on pilot
events.purpose: Decide on the pilot with blueprint and plan
events.decision: Does the blueprint justify running a pilot in one region?
agenda: Present the blueprint and the tested hypotheses
Review the wireframe prototype and the pilot plan
Decide whether the pilot goes ahead

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.purpose: Review readiness before the pilot goes live
events.decision: Is the marketplace ready to go live with pilot contractors?
agenda: Review the pilot KPIs and the distributor engagement plan
Review the first contractor target group
Discuss readiness to launch to pilot contractors

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot results
events.purpose: Review pilot launch and draft scale-up case
events.decision: Does the draft scale-up case reflect what the pilot shows so far?
agenda: Present the first version launched to pilot contractors
Review early contractor orders and distributor feedback
Discuss the draft scale-up business case

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Present pilot results and the scale-up case
events.decision: Is the pilot evidence enough to take the scale-up case to the 2027 budget round?
agenda: Present pilot results against the two success criteria
Review the business case, implementation plan and roadmap
Decide whether the case goes into the budget round

architect_notes: Phase lengths of 6 weeks Design and 14 weeks Pilot are an estimate; the brief gave only 20 weeks in total.
The marketplace is new, so the plan stops at the pilot in one region; rollout across Portugal and Spain is not in these phases.
Not covered by the phases: European Commission, digital product passports for construction products. Confirm whether it is in scope.
Departure from the archetype: the pilot drops 'Key internal hires identified' because the brief does not mention hiring, and adds distributor engagement.
